layout.arrangement: White slide canvas framed by a thin red rectangular border. Top area has a light gray header band. Inside the band, top-left, sits a light-blue title box with dark blue outline containing 'Feature Invariants'. Top-right corner holds a yellow circle with the slide number '33'. Below the header band, a large red-outlined content box fills most of the slide; inside it, a red bold header line 'Features Invariants are Problem dependent' (with 'Problem dependent' underlined and italic) appears at top, followed by four bullet points stacked vertically on the left.

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is bold, largest size. Header line 'Features Invariants are' is bold red; 'Problem dependent' is italic, underlined, dark gray/black. Bullets use small round bullet markers, regular weight black text. Note inconsistent capitalization: 'Translation invariant' uses lowercase 'i' while others use capital 'I'.

recreation_brief: 1. White background slide. 2. Draw a thin red (#CC3333) rectangle border around the full slide edge. 3. Add a light gray (#E8E8E8) band across the top ~15% of the slide. 4. Place a light blue (#CCE5FF) rectangle with dark blue (#0000CC) outline at top-left, overlapping the gray band; add bold black text 'Feature Invariants'. 5. Add a yellow (#FFFF99) circle with dark outline at top-right containing '33'. 6. Draw a second thin red rectangle inside the slide framing the content area below the title. 7. Near the top of the content box, add text: 'Features Invariants are ' in bold red, followed by 'Problem dependent' in italic underlined dark text. 8. Below, add four bullets in black: 'Rotation Invariant', 'Scaling Invariant', 'Translation invariant', 'Mirroring Invariant', each on its own line with round bullet markers, left-aligned.
